about: Requests for the skill trigger check (docs/skill-trigger.md). Each is written in a person's own words, not copied from any version's description, so no version gets an easy match. expect is the yad-* skill an agent should load first, or none; also lists other answers that are right too, for a request two skills genuinely share.
